item.tib: brten gsum rab gnas bskor kyis gyis lags khrigs gsal byed 'phrul gyi lde mig
item.coloph: de ltar rten gsum rab gnas 'phrin las lag khrigs phyag bzhes gsal byed 'phrul gyi lde dmigs (mig) zhes bya ba 'di/ dad ldan slob ma 'ga' yis yongs bskul nas/ bstan pa rnam gsum rjes bzhag la/ bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / bkra shis zhal dro byin che na/ 'gro ba ji snyed thar pa drangs pa'i phyir/ la byi btsun pa shes rab 'od zer bdag gis/ bka' lung bla ma'i dgongs don ci bzhin du/ blo dman rnams kyi go bde phyir/ me byi zla ba drug pa'i yar tshes la/ dgos 'dod 'byung gnas bkra shis sman ri nas bsgrigs pa/ phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu bde legs 'phel bar shog/ 'gal 'khrul nor ba ci mchis pa/ brtse ldan mkhas la bzod par gsol/ 'di sbyar las byung dge ba des/ mkha' khyab 'gro ba ji snyed kyis/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas la/ thams cad gzigs pa nyid thob shogag gsal byed 'di yang rgyal ba yi/ bstan pa ji srid gnas bar du/ nyi ma'i zer bzhin yongs khyab nas nas/ sems can don du smin rgyas shog/
